stemMd: What is the simplest neutral formula formed from aluminium ions with charge 3+ and oxide ions with charge 2−?
explanationMd: The least common total charge is six: two aluminium ions supply +6 and three oxide ions supply −6. The neutral ratio is therefore 2 to 3.

distractorRationale.b: This leaves a large net positive charge.
distractorRationale.a: This leaves a net positive charge per pair.
distractorRationale.d: One aluminium ion cannot balance three oxide ions.
